Short-code rule

One rule model for short and long dials. Mark=true = prefix key (classic exactMatch=false): e.g. code *101 matches *101# and *101123456# (Ethiopia MO). Exact (mark=false) wins on equality; longest mark prefix otherwise. Type = re-route = MAP2MAP Case 2: Redirect USSD + optional hop_dest_gt / hop_dest_ssn, then AS via as_url. Blank hop dest → HLR Face ussd.hlr.upper-gt (SSN 6). HTTP / gRPC / SIP = direct AS pull (no Case 2 hop). Use Edit on a Live rule to seed this form (incl. hop for *804#). Save updates the live map.

{{FORM_EDIT_BANNER}}

Case 2 hop + AdaptiveTimeout / Virtual Bridge at ingress; after hop, micro-jainslee routes AS via HTTP / gRPC / SIP (SLEE events). Hop fields below = DB hop_dest_gt / hop_dest_ssn. Direct to AS — no MAP2MAP hop. Plane = Type (HTTP|GRPC|SIP).

Persisted as rule_type (HTTP|GRPC|SIP) + reroute_enable. Not a separate wire invent.

After hop completes, AsPullRouter pulls this target on the AS plane above (HTTP URL / gRPC host|method / SIP trunkId).

{{TENANT_FIELD}} {{APP_USER_FIELD}}

Long MMI *{n}*xxx#: use mark=true and short code *804* (not *804#). MAP2MAP replaces only that prefix; leftover (incl. trailing #) is kept on the hop string.

MAP2MAP Case 2

Outbound MAP hop text (not SCCP GT). Exact short → literal (e.g. *875#). Long mark → prefix shape *875* so *804*1234# hops as *875*1234#. Chained RE_ROUTE rules re-apply the same suffix law.

Optional SCCP CalledParty GT (fixed peer, e.g. Digicom SP 251971200201). Blank → HLR Face upper-gt {{UPPER_HLR_GT}} from /admin/hlr (SSN 6). Never SRI/FAKE→MSC. {{HOP_ROLE_HINT}}
